0022600193.text: The Orlando Magic (2-6, 12th in the East, 5th in the Southeast) come in on a three-game losing streak, having gone 2-2 on the road and 0-4 at home, while the Golden State Warriors (5-3, 8th in the West, 2nd in the Pacific) are riding a five-game winning streak after going 3-1 at home. Orlando is missing Paolo Banchero, Jalen Suggs, Jonathan Isaac, Noah Penda, and Izaiyah Nelson, and Golden State is without Jimmy Butler III, Kristaps Porzingis, Moses Moody, and Gui Santos. The teams split their 2025-26 season series 1-1, with the Magic's most recent meeting a 120-97 loss in San Francisco on December 22, 2025, and they have not yet met this season.
